name: Parakeet-unified-en-0.6b — Best Hyperparam + Phonetic Phrase Expansion (Null Result) on Gold-92
short_description: Per-clip STT predictions from the default GPU-PB config plus 15 additional correct-spelling surface-form phrase variants (REZOLVE, Re-zolve, Rezolv, brain-powa, etc.) targeting the observed 'Rezolve'->'Resolve' confusion.
